description: Camera-ready values of the paper. Per layer, arrays are [checkpoint][seed]: OE and held-out score (test accuracy, or held-out R^2 for n-gram tasks) of the 3 real probes (seeds 1001-1003) and of the 3 type-matched control probes (label seeds 42-44; the control score is measured on the control labels). events: per-layer t^D, t^E and ln(t^E/t^D) as in the paper.
